messages.text:
BL-1873 — The rework rate counts a ticket as reworked only when it was actually bounced (its bounce_count, or bounce-named evidence), never because every role left pass evidence, and reads only the history its two windows need - on 2026-10-01 195 of 206 window tickets read as reworked, 80% of them on routine pass evidence alone, so the rate sat near 100% in both windows and neither the throttle nor the briefing verdict could ever fire, while each refresh walked the whole backlog history for 12 s at every promotion
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: Found by BL-1869's probes b and a (coder evidence BL-1869-coder-20261001.md), as BL-1869 said each confirmed probe would be a ticket of its own. FIRM - a closed ticket counts as reworked only on a recorded bounce, either a bounce_count above 0 on its YAML on main or an evidence file whose name says…
BL-1873 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1873" (or "reject BL-1873 <reason>") to act.
